title: Quick Ovened Kenyan Fish Braai
description: A spicy and crispy kenyan dish made with fish, shio-koji, and a sweet and tangy twist from raspberry jam.

ingredients.name: Raspberry jam
ingredients.notes: Use as a glaze during the last 10 minutes of cooking.

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: Brush the fish with olive oil before cooking.

ingredients.name: Fresh cilantro
ingredients.notes: Garnish with fresh cilantro after cooking.

ingredients.name: Lemon wedges
ingredients.notes: Serve with lemon wedges on the side.

instructions: Rinse the tilapia fillets and pat them dry with paper towels.
Mix shio-koji cure ingredients and apply to the fish for 30 minutes before cooking.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and place the fish on it.
Drizzle olive oil over the fish and sprinkle with paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Place the fish in the oven and bake for 12-15 minutes or until cooked through.
Brush the fish with raspberry jam during the last 10 minutes of cooking.
Remove the fish from the oven and garnish with chopped cilantro.
Serve the fish with sliced lemon wedges on the side.
